records.context: 1. find old spaCR files -- :func:`find_old_installs` 2. delete old spaCR files -- :func:`remove_install` 3. install new spaCR -- :func:`run_update_sequence` runs the install only after step 2 removed every installer-made copy.
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup#2
records.source: 1. find old spaCR files -- :func:`find_old_installs` 2. delete old spaCR files -- :func:`remove_install` 3. install new spaCR -- :func:`run_update_sequence` runs the install only after step 2 removed every installer-made copy.

records.context: Removal never runs an old version's own uninstaller, so a copy whose ``Uninstall.exe`` or ``uninstall-spacr.sh`` is missing or broken is removed all the same. Preferences and user data are kept: ``~/.spacr``, ``~/.cache/spacr``, ``~/.local/state/spacr``, ``~/spacr-demos``, ``~/spacr-tutorials``, the Hugging Face cache, and the ``spacr``/``qt`` settings (``~/.config/spacr``, the macOS preferences file, and the ``Software\spacr`` registry structured-data name on Windows).
records.label: spacr.install_cleanup#3
records.source: Removal never runs an old version's own uninstaller, so a copy whose ``Uninstall.exe`` or ``uninstall-spacr.sh`` is missing or broken is removed all the same. Preferences and user data are kept: ``~/.spacr``, ``~/.cache/spacr``, ``~/.local/state/spacr``, ``~/spacr-demos``, ``~/spacr-tutorials``, the Hugging Face cache, and the ``spacr``/``qt`` settings (``~/.config/spacr``, the macOS preferences file, and the ``Software\spacr`` registry key on Windows).
records.translation: Fjarlægingin keyrir aldrei eigið fjarlægingarforrit gamallar útgáfu, svo eintak þar sem ``Uninstall.exe`` eða ``uninstall-spacr.sh`` vantar eða er bilað er fjarlægt engu að síður. Stillingar og notendagögn eru varðveitt: ``~/.spacr``, ``~/.cache/spacr``, ``~/.local/state/spacr``, ``~/spacr-demos``, ``~/spacr-tutorials``, skyndiminni Hugging Face og stillingar ``spacr``/``qt`` (``~/.config/spacr``, stillingaskráin í macOS og lykillinn ``Software\spacr`` í kerfisskránni í Windows).

records.context: Used when the executing spaCR is itself an installer-made copy, which on Windows cannot delete itself while it executes. The helper waits for this process to exit, downloads the new installer, removes every older copy including the one that was executing, runs the installer, and starts the new version. records.translation: Notað þegar spaCR sem er í gangi er sjálft eintak sem uppsetningarforrit bjó til, en slíkt eintak getur í Windows ekki eytt sjálfu sér á meðan það keyrir. Hjálparferlið bíður eftir að þetta ferli hætti, sækir nýja uppsetningarforritið, fjarlægir hvert eldra eintak, þar á meðal það sem var í gangi, keyrir uppsetningarforritið og ræsir nýju útgáfuna. Ef ekki er hægt að fjarlægja eitthvert eintak sem uppsetningarforrit bjó til er ekkert sett upp og ástæðan er skrifuð í uppfærsluannálinn.

records.context: Ledger item 412. The maintainer asked for ten images of the Toxoplasma PV training set on Hugging Face as "a small test dataset for make masks", and "a button for loading this dataset which automatically triggers opening the first image with make masks".
records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_demo#1
records.source: Ledger item 412. The maintainer asked for ten images of the Toxoplasma PV training set on Hugging Face as "a small test dataset for make masks", and "a button for loading this dataset which automatically triggers opening the first image with make masks".
records.translation: Liður 412 í verkefnaskránni. Umsjónarmaðurinn bað um tíu myndir úr þjálfunarsafni Toxoplasma PV á Hugging Face sem „lítið prófunargagnasafn fyrir make masks“ og „hnapp til að hlaða þessu gagnasafni sem opnar sjálfkrafa fyrstu myndina í make masks“.

records.context: What is published. :data:`MAKE_MASKS_EXAMPLE_REPO` holds ten of the lab's own acquisitions -- no figure harvested from a paper, no held-out microscope field of view -- at the top level, their curated label masks under ``ground_truth_masks/``, a ``manifest.csv`` carrying each image's row from the in-house manifest, and one archive of all of it. The images open UNSEGMENTED: Make Masks reads drafts from ``masks/``, never from ``ground_truth_masks/``, so the editor starts on raw microscope fields of view and the truth sits beside them.
records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_demo#2
records.source: WHAT IS PUBLISHED. :data:`MAKE_MASKS_EXAMPLE_REPO` holds ten of the lab's own acquisitions -- no figure harvested from a paper, no held-out field -- at the top level, their curated label masks under ``ground_truth_masks/``, a ``manifest.csv`` carrying each image's row from the in-house manifest, and one archive of all of it. The images open UNSEGMENTED: Make Masks reads drafts from ``masks/``, never from ``ground_truth_masks/``, so the editor starts on raw fields and the truth sits beside them.
records.translation: HVAÐ ER BIRT. :data:`MAKE_MASKS_EXAMPLE_REPO` geymir efst tíu eigin myndatökur rannsóknarstofunnar -- engin mynd tekin úr grein, ekkert sjónsvið sem haldið er utan fyrir mat --, yfirfarnar merkingargrímur þeirra undir ``ground_truth_masks/``, ``manifest.csv`` með línu hverrar myndar úr innri innihaldsskránni og eitt skjalasafn með öllu saman. Myndirnar opnast ÁN BÚTUNAR: Make Masks les drög úr ``masks/``, aldrei úr ``ground_truth_masks/``, svo ritillinn byrjar á óunnum sjónsviðum og réttu grímurnar liggja við hliðina á þeim.

records.context: The same pattern as every other example set. One uncompressed ``.tar`` per repository, streamed to a ``.part`` file on a background execution unit behind the shared progress dialog, unpacked through the tar data filter (:class:`spacr.qt.hf_download._TarExampleWorker` does all of that), and cached: :func:`is_present` is asked first, so a second press opens the folder without a request.
records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_demo#3
records.source: THE SAME PATTERN AS EVERY OTHER EXAMPLE SET. One uncompressed ``.tar`` per repository, streamed to a ``.part`` file on a worker thread behind the shared progress dialog, unpacked through the tar data filter (:class:`spacr.qt.hf_download._TarExampleWorker` does all of that), and cached: :func:`is_present` is asked first, so a second press opens the folder without a request.
records.translation: SAMA MYNSTUR OG Í ÖLLUM ÖÐRUM SÝNISÖFNUM. Ein óþjöppuð ``.tar`` fyrir hverja geymslu, streymt í ``.part``-skrá á vinnsluþræði á bak við sameiginlega framvindugluggann, afpökkuð með gagnasíu tar (:class:`spacr.qt.hf_download._TarExampleWorker` sér um allt þetta) og geymd í skyndiminni: fyrst er spurt :func:`is_present`, svo annar smellur opnar möppuna án nýrrar beiðni.

records.context: Its own folder, not the shared laboratory microplate. The Measure and Annotate sets unpack into ``example_plate_folder()`` because they compose into one laboratory microplate. These ten microscope fields of view are not part of that laboratory microplate, and the Mask demo decides it is present by finding ``*.tif`` there, so unpacking them into it would make that demo think it had been downloaded.
records.label: spacr.qt.make_masks_demo#4
records.source: ITS OWN FOLDER, NOT THE SHARED PLATE. The Measure and Annotate sets unpack into ``example_plate_folder()`` because they compose into one plate. These ten fields are not part of that plate, and the Mask demo decides it is present by finding ``*.tif`` there, so unpacking them into it would make that demo think it had been downloaded.
records.translation: EIGIN MAPPA, EKKI SAMEIGINLEGA PLATAN. Söfnin fyrir „Mæling“ og „Merking“ eru afpökkuð í ``example_plate_folder()`` því saman mynda þau eina plötu. Þessi tíu sjónsvið eru ekki hluti af þeirri plötu, og sýnidæmið fyrir „Grímur“ ákveður hvort það sé til staðar með því að finna ``*.tif`` þar, svo ef þau væru afpökkuð þangað héldi það sýnidæmi að það hefði þegar verið sótt.

records.context: Why this is a module and not a method. The screen gets one call in its navigation row. Everything else lives here, so ``make_masks.py`` -- which several items edit at once -- carries a two-line hook.

records.source: WHY THIS IS A MODULE AND NOT A METHOD. The screen gets one call in its navigation row. Everything else lives here, so ``make_masks.py`` -- which several items edit at once -- carries a two-line hook.
records.translation: HVERS VEGNA ÞETTA ER EINING EN EKKI AÐFERÐ. Skjámyndin fær eitt kall í leiðsagnarlínu sinni. Allt annað er hér, svo ``make_masks.py`` -- sem margir liðir breyta samtímis -- ber aðeins tveggja lína krók.
